page.title: AI Agent
page.subtitle: Generate reviewable code changes in an isolated copy of a registered project.

compose.title: Describe a code change
compose.noProjects: Add a local folder with the button above before starting an Agent task.
compose.noProviders: No provider is configured. Set AI provider values in the local service environment; API keys stay out of the renderer.
compose.promptPlaceholder: Describe the intended change, constraints, and how you want the result structured.
compose.disclosureBody: Starting this task sends your prompt and up to {{maxFiles}} eligible UTF-8 files from a bounded isolated copy to the selected provider. Source text is redacted and capped at {{maxKiB}} KiB after redaction. Secret-shaped paths and built-in dependency/build folders are skipped. Supported project .gitignore rules are applied; malformed or unsupported patterns stop workspace creation.
compose.consent: I reviewed this disclosure and authorize sending this task's bounded source context to the selected provider.
compose.footerNote: Candidate edits stay under the task workspace in app data.
compose.runtimeNote: The agent plans, calls real tools in an isolated workspace, runs build/tests, repairs failures and reviews its own diff. High-risk actions pause for your approval.

history.title: Task history
history.emptyDetail: New proposals and their saved state will appear here.

review.title: Isolated change review
review.emptyTitle: Select a task to inspect its result
review.emptyDetail: Generated file changes are shown here; the registered project stays untouched.
review.changesError: Changes could not be read from the isolated workspace: {{message}}
review.deletedNote: This deletion occurred inside the isolated workspace.
review.runningNote: The task is running. Its workspace and disclosed paths will appear as they are recorded.
review.noDiff: No file changes were generated for this task.
review.retryNote: Retry creates a new isolated task and requires fresh source disclosure.

capabilityNote: This version records task state and creates reviewable changes in an isolated copy. It does not apply changes to the registered folder, execute commands, run tests, or provide Git apply/rollback controls.

replyLanguage.instruction: Please write your explanations in {{language}}. Keep all code, commands, identifiers and file paths unchanged.

policy.standard: Standard — auto workspace writes, approve risky

providers.title: AI providers & keys
providers.empty: No providers registered yet. Add one to enable real agent runs.
providers.encryptionUnavailable: OS key encryption unavailable — keys cannot be saved
providers.keyPlaceholder: Paste API key (stored encrypted, never displayed again)
providers.keyNote: API keys are encrypted with the operating system credential store, never shown again, never written to logs or project files, and forwarded only to the local service process.
providers.formIncomplete: Name, base URL and model are required.
